resources.string: For reverse proxy setups, for example /lidarr. Changing this requires a restart.
Open the Lidarr web UI in a browser when the server starts.
Certificate files are managed in the server config directory.
Authentication is handled by an external proxy; Lidarr trusts the remote user header.
Send anonymous usage and error information to the Lidarr team. This includes information on your browser, which Lidarr pages you use, error reporting, and installation version.
Tags apply to artists, lists, indexers, and other consumers to drive automation.
Deleting a tag removes it from every artist, list, indexer, and rule that uses it.
No backups yet. Create one now or wait for the scheduled backup.
Restoring replaces the current database and settings with the backup\'s contents. Lidarr will restart during the restore.
Update installation started; Lidarr will restart.
